title: Claude’s new rules against game cloning won’t stop the AI copying boom
script:
Anthropic just updated its acceptable use policy to block AI game cloning.
The company now explicitly prohibits using Claude to clone or replicate existing software products.
This move targets the recent surge in AI-generated clones of popular indie games.
Anthropic faces a massive hurdle because these rules only apply to its hosted services.
The Ars Technica report notes that model makers cannot control how developers use model weights.
Once models are released, they often run on local hardware without any central oversight.
Policy updates cannot stop the massive, decentralized wave of AI-powered software copying.
Can any company truly stop this?
